reviews.name: Oliver L.
reviews.body: Der Tisch ist einfach nur der Wahnsinn - genau so wie ich ihn wollte (oder dachte, dass ich ihn wollte). Und genau hier liegt eine der Stärken von David und seinem Team. Ich wusste nur, dass ich so einen Tisch wollte, was genau war mir aber nicht klar. David lotste mich durch jeden einzelnen Schritt, von der Auswahl des Holzes wie auch der Wahl des am besten dazu passenden Epoxyharzes und das war bei meiner Unentschlossenheit gar nicht so einfach. Die Qualität des Tisches ist perfekt, der Versand ging dann doch schneller als gedacht und David war jederzeit bestens darüber informiert, wo der Tisch gerade war und was am besten zu tun wäre wenn irgendwas passiert. Vielen Dank an das gesamte Team für mein neues Schmuckstück - das nächste wird nicht lange auf sich warten lassen (sobald ich weiß, was als nächstes möchte).

reviews.name: Ellen
reviews.body: Amazing experience! David communicated with me throughout the entire process and it was amazing to see it come to life! He made adjustments where we asked and was incredibly accommodating and patient. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.name: Ahmet C.
reviews.title: Kaliteli ve Özenli
reviews.body: Titizlikle ambalajlanmıştı. Kargoda hasar alması neredeyse imkansız, sadece ambalajları açmamız yarım saat sürdü. Kurulumu son derece basit, alyan anahtar ile sıkılabilen vidalar, ve vidaların yuvaları halihazırda masa tablasının altında, hangi ayağı sağa, hangisini sola monte edeceğiniz ince düşünülerek bir bant ile işaretlenmiş bir şekilde gönderilmişti. Vidalar küçük bir ambalaj içerisinde, ayakların olduğu paketin içerisinden çıktı. Masa tablasının üzerinde titizlikle çalışılmış, kusursuzca işlenmiş, tek bir kusur bulamadım ki takıntılı biriyim bu konularda. Masa ağır ve montajı çok sağlam olduğundan asla sallanma yapmıyor. Satın alım sonrası sürekli WhatsApp üzerinden diyalog halinde bilgilendirildim, sorularıma sabırla cevap verildi, çok teşekkür ediyorum.

reviews.name: Danielle M.
reviews.body: This is a gorgeous table. It’s heavy and solid, the material is quality, and it’s super easy to attach the legs. It was very well protected for shipping and the seller was communicative!

reviews.name: Marisa G.
reviews.body: Beautiful table, exactly what I had been searching for. Well made, high quality. Shipping was surprisingly quick. Would 100% recommend or buy again from this seller!

reviews.name: david
reviews.body: This is a truly fabulous piece of furniture, pictures do not do the real thing justice. asked David if he could make a bespoke size which he said ok, arrived very well wrapped and secure. easy to assemble. have not seen anything like it available in UK. a really unique piece . Thanyou

reviews.name: Rhonda C.
reviews.body: This table exceeded our expectations! It is beautiful with a smooth matte finish. It's built very solid and easy to assemble. Shop owner was very communicative, polite and prompt with customer service.

reviews.name: christina c.
reviews.body: I live in a 380 sq ft studio and needed a small table. I admired HardenWoodCo's round table but required a pedestal version instead. After requesting a custom order, David was kind and agreed to build it, exceeding my expectations. The 32-inch round walnut table has a warm undertone and a near-matte finish, smooth and flawless. Assembly was easy with the numbered tape pieces, and David kept me informed about a slight delivery delay (which was NOT a problem for custom orders). For those seeking the right-sized table, this one is perfect! It comfortably fits two 10.5-inch plates, with room for a third. A fourth plate is a tight fit but doable. Highly recommend this table, it's better than the options from West Elm and Pottery Barn!

reviews.name: Angelika B.
reviews.body: Wunderschöner Tisch, tolle Qualität und sehr einfach zusammenzubauen. Zollgebühren nicht vergessen, das war mir nicht so bewusst, weil ich selten im Ausland bestelle.

reviews.name: Marisa G.
reviews.body: Gorgeous table! Very sturdy and will last AT LEAST my lifetime. Buy it! But… don’t forget Trump hit Turkey with a 15% import tariff that DHL will collect from you before delivery. Thankfully, this seller often has markdowns that off-set that fee.

reviews.name: Kalei C.
reviews.body: Table is absolutely gorgeous -- solid, beautifully made, and the perfect size (it's actually somewhat difficult to find a table this size). Others I have looked at from various large-scale manufacturers do not compare, especially considering the price and free shipping. I purchased this during a sale and would have paid a similar amount for a table of much lower quality if I had purchased from a retail store. Seller and shipping company provided excellent communication. Packing was excellent, and shipping was very fast, even though the item had to travel from Turkey!

reviews.name: Connie G.
reviews.body: This item is gorgeous. Was easy to put together. Seller was very responsive to questions. Definitely recommend. I'm giving 4 stars only because it needed a few coats of polyurethane for protection as I am using it as a bistro table.

reviews.name: Alison S.
reviews.body: Stunning table. Craftsmanship of this table is superb. The table was very well packaged and care was taken to protect the wood. Would definitely recommend this seller.

reviews.name: Daan
reviews.body: Very happy with the table. Absolutely beautiful walnut wood. Very well packaged and clear install instructions. Really glad how it turned out!

reviews.name: Belinda A.
reviews.body: Absolutely gorgeous table. My mother loves it, and I love the wood quality. And the customer service is exceptional.
